name: The Roelle furniture-finishing works, Mather Street

function.note: 'Used by the Roelle Furniture-finishing Company, and ... filled with combustible materials' (Andreas vol. 2, pp. 717-718).

built.note: Not known: reconstructed as standing through the later 1860s.

research_note: THE ROELLE BUILDING, built by T-3831: 'Eleven feet south of the mills stood a three-story building, fifty by seventy feet, siding on Mather Street', the Roelle Furniture-finishing Company's; with the engines working on it and on Bateham's property 'the Roelle structure went up in smoke and flame' (Andreas vol. 2, pp. 717-718). No picture of it is known.

documented_range.note: Standing on the night of the fire (Andreas vol. 2, pp. 717-718); when it was built is not known.

position.symbolic_location: Mather Street, north side, west of Canal Street.
position.note: Its long side on the line of Mather Street, eleven feet south of the main mill (Andreas pp. 717-718); set under the main mill's south end, reconstructed. The footprint's origin is local E -162.6 N -1531.0; the frame is turned onto the 1871 plan's grid.

derivation.reason: Laid out from Andreas's description of the block against the 1871 plan's Clinton and Canal streets and the line of Mather Street; no traced frontage for the 1871 city is in data/traces/street_control.json to recompute it from.

footprint.note: Fifty by seventy feet, 'siding on Mather Street' (Andreas pp. 717-718).

blocks.name: the works
blocks.note: A three-storey building (Andreas), built as a plain frame factory with a flat roof and a light cornice; its openings are reconstructed.

value.note: THE ROELLE BUILDING, built by T-3831.

fire.note: 'In the very face of those efforts, the Roelle structure went up in smoke and flame', just before half-past ten (Andreas p. 718).

composition.note: Its size and storeys are Andreas's; its frame walls, flat roof and openings are reconstructed.

wall_material.value: Weathered boards on a frame, a flat roof
wall_material.note: Not stated: taken to be frame, as its neighbours were.

phases.change_note: Built T-3831 (2026-11-28): the Roelle works on Mather Street.
